pages.title: Your communication experiences
paragraphs: We want to understand what helps you when someone has difficulty understanding your speech. We will also ask about using speech recognition to help with conversations, messages, or writing.
You can choose answers instead of typing. When you want to write, a few words are enough. You can skip questions, take a break, or stop. There are no right or wrong answers.
Please allow up to 60 minutes. You can pause and return later.

We record your survey selections and changes, including text you type or delete and the time of each action. This happens only inside this survey. Deleted or unsubmitted text may remain in the research interaction log.

pages.title: Example situations
paragraphs: Imagine that you are talking to someone and your device can show you what they understood. We will show you a few examples and ask what you would do next.
For each example, choose what you would do. You can skip any example.

pages.title: What would you do first in this situation?

scenario.title: Example 1 — At a pharmacy
scenario.situation: You are at a pharmacy counter. You do not know the staff member, and people are waiting behind you.
scenario.meant: “I’m picking up the prescription for Mara Klein.”
scenario.shown: “I’m picking up the prescription for Mark Line.”

options: Continue with the text as it is
Say it in a different way
Change the text and show it
Type or write a new message
Stop trying to communicate this message

pages.title: What would you change?

when.question: s1_action
values: Change the text and show it

pages.title: Take a break if you would like
paragraphs: Next is a short demonstration. You can pause here and come back when you are ready.

pages.title: Would you like to watch the demonstration?
paragraphs: We will show a possible way to use speech recognition. A person speaks, sees the text, and corrects a word. The system then produces a new version of the remaining text. The new text may still contain mistakes.
You can pause or skip the demonstration.
